correctness.rationale: A complete all-length proof first equates binary universality with path matching, then cyclic universality with cycle matching. The even transition-parity condition yields two source words per feasible vector. The 3x3 weighted cyclic transfer matrix has a unique path except on the all-one alternating vector, corrected exactly once per parity evaluation, so the eigenvalue and bivariate distribution formulas follow. Coefficients follow from the circular matching count; derivatives yield exact moments. The standalone source verifier exhaustively checked 131070 words through n=16, direct subsequences and matching for n<=10, and polynomial identities through n=80. Edge cases n=1,2 and unary words are addressed by definitions.

value.rationale: Circular subword universality has a natural independent mathematical motivation in subsequence theory. The result gives a complete fixed-length distribution of its index across all binary words, exact typical value and dispersion, and a cycle-matching structural model with a necessary even-length correction. This is a natural complete classification, not an arbitrary finite slice, textbook exercise, or routine numerical increment.
